name: 11 - BrewTec Employee Payroll Details Secure Form

parameters.content:
## 11. Employee payroll details secure form
The new hire enters IBAN, tax ID, social security number, tax class and health insurance. Workflow 4 e-mails a personal single-use link (14 days) and repeats it every 3 days until submitted. The form also asks for the personal code from the welcome e-mail. After 5 wrong codes the link locks.

**Setup**
1. Run 05_payroll.sql and create the key in Supabase Vault (see the file).
2. Postgres credential on Check link and Encrypt and save.
3. Publish. Settings > Error workflow: 6.

**Protection**
Checked here (IBAN mod 97, tax ID check digit, social security check digit) and again in the database. Encrypted with AES-256 inside Postgres, key in Supabase Vault. This workflow saves NO execution data (Settings), so n8n never stores the values. Pages are not cached, not framed, keep the link on BrewTec pages and run no scripts.
